summary: Remove Record Relation: severs a link between a target record and a named relation field of an owner record.
description: The inverse of Add Record Relation: when `store` fires, the record in `targetId` is removed from the configured relation field of the record in `modelId`. `relationRemoved` confirms the server accepted it; `failure`/`error` report problems. Removing a relation never deletes either record — it only unlinks them.
whenToUse: Undoing relation links: leaving a project, unfavouriting, untagging. To delete the record itself use Delete Record.

ports.modelId: Id of the owner record whose relation field loses a link.
ports.targetId: Id of the record being unlinked.
ports.relationRemoved: Signal; the unlink was confirmed by the server.

runtimeBehavior: Class and relation-name configuration is schema-driven exactly as on Add Record Relation (declared-port-groups + runtime-discovered); ports depend on the project's database schema.
